info.name: Paddy Service - Live API
info.description: Paddy Service - Live API. Environment variable paddy_api_url is configured as http://103.97.109.117/paddyapi. The collection has the same default, so URLs resolve even without selecting the environment. Login URL: {{paddy_api_url}}/auth/login. Use environment credentials: admin_email/admin_password, or login_email/login_password, or login_phone/login_password for drivers. Login tokens are saved automatically in collection variables. Send mutations manually. Live connectivity has not been verified.

request.description: Common login: for admin set admin_email and admin_password in the Live API environment. For another account set login_email and login_password. For driver set login_phone and login_password, keeping login_email blank. Tokens are saved automatically in collection variables.

exec: if ((!email && !phone) || (email && phone) || !password) { pm.execution.skipRequest(); throw new Error('Set login_password and exactly one of login_email or login_phone.'); }
